🎨 Quick Sale Customization

📏 Card Size

Make the Quick Sale cards smaller or bigger. Saved on this device (phone and computer can have different sizes).

Normal

🧩 Card Layout

Drag a card (hold & move) to change its position or to move it to another line. Add as many lines as you like — 2, 3, 4 or more.

🎨 Colors

Every Quick Sale item is grouped and colored automatically by the first word of its name — items sharing the same first word always share the same color. Pick a custom color for a group below, or leave it on Auto.

📉 Low Stock Report

Items with stock below 10. Remove any item you don't want in the report using the ✕ button, then print or save as PDF.

💾 Data Center — Backup & Restore

Stock & sales now sync live to your Firebase cloud database, so every device signed into the same Firebase project sees the same data. For extra safety, still make regular backups below — CSV backup files can be opened in Excel and CSV files exported by this app can be restored here.

Export / Backup

Auto Daily Backup

Import / Restore

Complete JSON Restore

Restores stock, sales and latest invoice.

Stock CSV Restore

Required columns: name, qty, selling_price. Optional: id, purchase_price, barcode, category, model.

Sales CSV Restore

Restores sales history from CSV exported by this app.

🔑 Change Password

For security, a password-change link is sent to the shop's Gmail inbox. Open the email, tap the link and choose a new password there. Nothing is changed until you do that. Passwords are handled by Firebase Authentication and are never stored in this app.

Link will be sent to: muhammadiafinance@gmail.com
